## Checklist

- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` and `claude plugin validate .` pass
- [ ] A change to what a skill does has an eval case in `evals/<name>.json`
- [ ] EN and RU mirrors (README, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT) changed together
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a line under the next version
